author: Kris Ploch
name: MrPloch application (Spectre console + EF Core data layer)

siblingsRoot.description: Relative path (with a trailing backslash) from the generated repository root to the parent folder that holds the side-by-side ploch-* sibling repositories. The default assumes the new repo is cloned directly beside ploch-common, ploch-data, ploch-commandline and mrploch-development.

skipRestore.description: Skip the automatic 'dotnet restore' run after the project is created.

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by this project.
